library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Follow the same fake-HttpClient pattern used in tests/src/com.azure/azure-security-keyvault-secrets and azure-data-appconfiguration: build BlobServiceClient/BlobContainerClient/BlobClient via their builders' .httpClient(HttpClient) hook with a dummy StorageSharedKeyCredential (fake account name + base64 key — no real auth is checked by the mock). Note the Storage Blob REST API returns XML (not JSON) for list/metadata operations (e.g. ListBlobsFlatSegmentResponse), so canned responses need XML bodies, not JSON. Expect the usual --initialize-at-build-time flags for org.slf4j.helpers.NOPLoggerFactory/SubstituteLoggerFactory and com.fasterxml.jackson.core.Base64Variant seen in sibling azure-core-http-netty-based tests; the normal native-image fix loop will surface and add these if missing.
risks: azure-storage-internal-avro (used for blob change-feed/query features) pulls Apache Avro, which has had reflection-heavy native-image compatibility issues in other projects — if the generated test exercises change-feed/query APIs, extra native-image reflect-config may surface during the fix loop; this is a compile/run-fix concern, not a pre-setup blocker.
library_preparation_preflight.summary: azure-storage-blob:12.29.0's dependencies (azure-xml, azure-core, azure-core-http-netty, azure-storage-common, azure-storage-internal-avro) resolve transitively via the single generated testImplementation line. This repo's established pattern for Azure/cloud-storage SDKs (azure-security-keyvault-secrets, azure-data-appconfiguration, software.amazon.awssdk:s3) is to test with a hand-written fake HttpClient returning canned REST responses and a dummy StorageSharedKeyCredential, never a Docker emulator or live account — no Azurite/testcontainers precedent exists anywhere in tests/src or allowed-docker-images/. No required env var or system property was found.
